event_name: Time 19:55 2021 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 March 2021 The Stewards Title Decision - Qualifying Yellow Flags Description Decision - Qualifying Yellow Flags
fact: The cars below were alleged to not have respected single waved yellow flags at Turn 8 at 18:18h
incident_time: 19:55 The Stewards, having received reports from the Race Director, have considered the following matters and determine the following
offence: Alleged Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5.b of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing and telemetry evidence and each car took appropriate action in the yellow flag sector. In each case, the driver set a slower time in the sector, drove appropriately by the video, and telemetry showed they took appropriate actions. Three other cars drove through the sector during the yellow, but there was clearly no need to investigate their actions as they were significantly slower.
title: Decision Qualifying Yellow Flags
